title: Docs: forge .keys URL as copy source; no key refs
description: Mark 2026-10-23: person files store literal keys only, never a forge ref (github:user) or a URL to an .asc. Reasons: registry must answer from git alone, offline and reproducibly; the signature must cover the key itself, not a pointer whose content can change (forge would become a trust root); check stays offline. A GPG .asc URL is useless (git-vouch never runs gpg; continuity is checked against pgpkeys at the freeze commit; newcomers' GPG keys prove nothing). Add: one sentence in docs/guide-regulars.md (forge <user>.keys URL is a handy place to copy your SSH key from, e.g. curl -s https://github.com/<user>.keys, then git vouch register with the literal key); one row in DESIGN.md Rejected alternatives (key references / forge-sourced keys in person files). Queued until the follow-up workflow releases the docs.
acceptance_criteria: Guide sentence and DESIGN rejected-alternatives row present; the shown command matches git vouch register's real syntax (checked against git vouch register --help); doc tests still pass.
close_reason: docs/guide-regulars.md Register without one: forge .keys URL as a copy source, register the saved .pub; DESIGN.md Rejected alternatives: key references or forge-sourced keys in person files
